_comment: Machine-readable gate manifest for the release/build process. Each milestone maps to the single command that PROVES it (exit 0 = met). tier: which test tier the gate runs at. requires: host capabilities (the rig-level superset; the K3SM_CI_REQUIRE test-level taxonomy is a subset). manual: true gates run only under K3SM_LAB=1 (else reported 'pending lab', never auto-greened). skeleton: true marks a row whose gate is NOT yet the real proof (an honesty-contract placeholder) — TestLabSkeletonHonesty keys on manual:true AND skeleton:true (real manual gates m3/m6.sh are manual:true WITHOUT skeleton, so they are excluded), and the manual:false skeletons (m7/m10) are pinned always-red (# K3SM-SKELETON sentinel) by TestNonManualSkeletonsAlwaysRed. args: the argument vector the gate is invoked with (omitted = none) — TestPhasesGatePathsResolve os.Stats the gate PATH, so a mode-selecting flag cannot live in gate; it needs this field rather than a _comment, because the m9 launch ledger's contract is that the row set is machine-enumerable and a comment is not. Flip skeleton off (or remove it) when the real gate lands. Gates for unstarted milestones are authored as that milestone's work runs. STRUCTURE: a milestone with BOTH a CI-runnable integration slice and a lab-only slice has two rows — the canonical M<n> key is the integration gate that runs in CI; the M<n>-lab key is the lab gate (two-macs/vz, manual). M3 splits this way (single-node NodePort+PVC integration vs cross-node mesh/DNS lab); M4 splits this way (RBAC/conformance integration vs packaging/launchd lab). M7 umbrella gate execs the m7/{ci,docs,hygiene}.sh sub-gates, which live OUTSIDE the m[0-9]*.sh orphan glob by design (hack/acceptance/m7/) so the one-canonical-gate contract holds without glob surgery.

M4-lab._comment: re-pointed 2026-07 → hack/lab/m7.sh: the reboot-survival proof needs the M7.1 brew/pkg artifact, so it is superseded by the M7-lab gate and runs in the M7 tail (B35 tombstoned; the old hack/lab/m4.sh skeleton is deleted in the same change).

M10.3-ingress._comment: M10.3 sub-gate: Ingress hosting + IngressClass + svclb LB status. It asserts against a RUNNING cluster ($KUBECONFIG + the high-port --ingress-http-port listener) and boots NOTHING itself, so it is manual (the operator/orchestrator supplies the cluster); the privileged :80/:443 netd-authorized leg is the M10-lab slice.

M11-core._comment: The LAUNCH row: the functional-EXPERIMENTAL vm path linux/arm64 must demonstrate before v0.1 ships (amd64 is the v0.2.x follow-on per the M11 plan's R26/R28, and the CORE legs carry an amd64 NEGATIVE assertion instead) — a STRICT SUBSET of M11-lab, selected by the --core arg. requires deliberately OMITS signing: the M11 plan's R28 removed Developer-ID from this path, and a signing requirement would make the row unrunnable. Evidence convention: hack/lab/runs/README.md.

M11-lab._comment: The FULL B109 vm-path ledger (no args). A --core green NEVER satisfies this row.
